recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-31783 unless BR&R later changes the product-definition route modelling pattern.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting clearer documentation for why the redundant MedicinalProductDefinition route concept and AdministrableProductDefinition.routeOfAdministration.code both exist, and how they should be used consistently.
initial_application: FHIR-31859 first removed the old MedicinalProductDefinition.administrableProduct backbone and moved the simple route code to MedicinalProductDefinition.route. FHIR-31783 was then applied by ca3b2129dc and 71a4873af9, adding wording that MedicinalProductDefinition.route is the same concept as AdministrableProductDefinition.routeOfAdministration.code and that they cannot be used together, plus the apd-1 invariant. FHIR-39755 later corrected the invariant expression in dd0e8e7755 without changing that intent.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps MedicinalProductDefinition and AdministrableProductDefinition active in the BR&R build. Current source contains both MPD-side and APD-side explanatory text and the corrected apd-1 invariant. Jira search found only the seed and FHIR-39755 for the exact current route/invariant relationship; Zulip and Confluence searches found no superseding discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active StructureDefinition XML already conveys and enforces the FHIR-31783 decision.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the simple route-or-full-administrable-product pattern that FHIR-31783 later questioned.
Removed MedicinalProductDefinition.administrableProduct and moved the simple route concept to MedicinalProductDefinition.route before the FHIR-31783 clarification was applied.
Corrected the apd-1 FHIRPath expression while preserving the FHIR-31783 rule that APD route and MPD route are not used together.
Rejected the broader proposal to collapse product-definition resources, supporting retention of separate resource boundaries with clarifying guidance.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requesting clearer documentation for redundant MedicinalProductDefinition and AdministrableProductDefinition route concepts.
evidence_items.learned: Final WG intent was to improve documentation and add an invariant so implementations use either the simple route code or the full administrable product route, not a hybrid.

evidence_items.summary: MedicinalProductDefinition.route says it is the same concept as AdministrableProductDefinition.routeOfAdministration.code and that they cannot be used together.
evidence_items.learned: The MPD-side clarification requested by FHIR-31783 is present in active source.

evidence_items.summary: AdministrableProductDefinition has apd-1 and routeOfAdministration prose forbidding use when the referenced formOf product has MedicinalProductDefinition.route.
evidence_items.learned: The APD-side documentation and conformance rule implement the same no-hybrid route policy.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-31783 history added the route clarification and apd-1 invariant; FHIR-39755 later corrected the invariant expression.
evidence_items.learned: Current source is the evolved application of the published Jira decision rather than an omitted change.

evidence_items.learned: The inspected structure definitions are in current build scope.
